content: Figure FIGREF11 shows an example of OLAC metadata. The source document described with this metadata record is a PDF structured into chapters, with text corresponding to the CEFR level A2 and images. Metadata in OLAC can be converted into the metadata standard of CLARIN (a European research infrastructure for language resources and technology), the Component MetaData Infrastructure (CMDI). The CMDI standard was chosen since it is the supported metadata version of CLARIN, which is specifically popular in German-speaking countries.
